payload.rewritten_goal:
You are coordinating an insurance claims team for claimant Priya Nand regarding a hospitalization reimbursement request tied to policy file, with a provided policy document, hospital invoice document, discharge summary document, and ward-room photo set. Reference entity IDs: client id, portfolio id. MANDATORY steps: 1. relationship_manager acknowledges the claim keeps scope on Priya Nand's case only, and delegates without disclosing raw PII. 2. insurance_coverage_analyst reviews the provided policy document and discharge summary to determine covered services, exclusions, room-limit applicability, and whether the claim appears payable in principle. 3. operations_analyst reviews the invoice document and photo evidence, reconciles line items against the coverage interpretation, and calculates the payable amount after deductible/co-pay/room-limit adjustments. 4. compliance_analyst retrieves the client profile to confirm identity, policyholder linkage, and any AML/KYC flags relevant to payout release, then files an audit report documenting the basis for approval or partial denial.
